versions.content: If more than one Xxx_Indication function called, accord- ing to [SWS_Dcm_00516], has returned E_NOT_OK and no function has returned E_REQUEST_NOT_ACCEPTED, the DSD submodule shall trigger a negative re- sponse using the ErrorCode parameter from the first Xxx_Indication returning E_NOT_OK.
